defects.description: The term 'Subject' is translated as 'Субъект' instead of the required glossary equivalent 'Объект обсуждения'.
The field key 'severity' in the technical schema was translated, which breaks the specification.
The field name 'severity' is translated in the descriptive text, creating inconsistency with the other field 'subject_id' which remained in English.
Enum values for the 'outcome' field were translated; technical identifiers/constants should remain in English.
The enum value 'blocked-escalation' was translated within a logic rule, which changes the technical meaning of the condition.
